name: [SMIOT][Ca 3] Probe ngoai bao app khong tra HTTP (smiot.external.app_up)
message:
Ca 3 - probe ngoai tien trinh (smiot-external-probe.timer) khong goi duoc /healthz (hoac /login) cua smiot.

Luu y: metric smiot.* ben trong app ngung phat khi app chet (no-data), nen monitor nay dung metric smiot.external.* tu tien trinh rieng.

Quyet dinh (theo guard, khong tu y restart):
- smiot.service inactive/failed + mongod + mosquitto khoe + dia < 85% + doc duoc Mongo -> chi duoc 'systemctl start smiot.service' qua guard, cooldown 300 s.
- smiot.service van active nhung HTTP loi -> guard TU CHOI (khong restart, khong mat bang chung): dieu tra tay.
- Mau MongoDB van moi (smiot.external.sample_age_seconds thap) -> app van ghi du lieu: KHONG restart.

Phuc hoi chi duoc coi la xong khi: smiot.external.app_up = 1, HTTP 200, VA co mau MongoDB moi hon moc luc dung. Bits Investigation chua xac nhan phuc hoi.

Day la monitor bo sung; monitor 340356283 (systemd.unit.active) van giu nguyen.

{{#is_no_data}}Probe ngoai khong gui metric: kiem tra smiot-external-probe.timer va Datadog Agent (DogStatsD 8125).{{/is_no_data}}
{{#is_recovery}}Probe bao app_up=1. Doi chieu mau MongoDB moi truoc khi ghi 'recovered'.{{/is_recovery}}
